summary.text: Lily Qi is a Democratic member of the Maryland House of Delegates from District 15 who has served since January 9, 2019, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Qi succeeded Aruna Miller in the House of Delegates and advanced from the Democratic primary on June 23, 2026.
For 2025-2026 Ballotpedia lists her as House Chair of the Fair Practices and State Personnel Oversight Committee and a member of the Economic Matters Committee.
